title: Fix three bugs in a Python Queue class
description: Fix bugs in Queue: dequeue uses pop() instead of pop(0) giving LIFO not FIFO, front returns last element not first, size has off-by-one.

files.tests/test_queue.py:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from src.queue import Queue


def test_fifo_order():
    q = Queue()
    q.enqueue(1)
    q.enqueue(2)
    q.enqueue(3)
    assert q.dequeue() == 1
    assert q.dequeue() == 2


def test_front():
    q = Queue()
    q.enqueue(5)
    q.enqueue(10)
    assert q.front() == 5  # front returns oldest
    assert q.size() == 2   # front is non-destructive


def test_size():
    q = Queue()
    assert q.size() == 0
    q.enqueue('a')
    q.enqueue('b')
    q.enqueue('c')
    assert q.size() == 3

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in src/queue.py:
1. dequeue: change `self._items.pop()` to `self._items.pop(0)` for FIFO order
2. front: change `self._items[-1]` to `self._items[0]` to return the oldest element
3. size: change `len(self._items) + 1` to `len(self._items)`
All 3 tests must pass.
